details.description: Code Llama 13B Python is the Python-specialized, 13-billion-parameter variant in Meta's Code Llama family, produced by further training the base model on 100 billion additional tokens of mostly-Python data, per Meta's Code Llama research paper. It is an auto-regressive transformer intended for Python code synthesis and understanding rather than general instruction-following, and like the rest of the family is trained on 16k-token sequences with Meta reporting improved handling of inputs up to 100,000 tokens.
advantages: Fine-tuned on 100 billion additional, mostly-Python tokens beyond the base model, per Meta's Code Llama research paper.
Scores 43.3% pass@1 on HumanEval, ahead of the same-size base model (36.0%), per Meta's Code Llama research paper (Table 2).
disadvantages: Specialized for Python; Meta's model card describes the family as covering multiple languages but this variant is optimized specifically for Python.
Not instruction-tuned, so it is not intended as a conversational assistant the way the Instruct variant is.
Meta's model card states it is intended for commercial and research use in English and relevant programming languages.

sources.title: Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code (arXiv:2308.12950)

notes: The huggingface.co/blog/codellama table (previously cited for the 42.89% HumanEval figure and the '100B additional Python tokens' detail) is explicitly labeled on the page as sourced from Hugging Face's own multilingual code leaderboard, not from Meta's official release numbers, so the score has been dropped per the verify pass's rule against a blog's own test runs; the '100 billion additional tokens' detail is independently confirmed in Meta's own paper (Table 1: Code Llama - Python trained on an additional 100B tokens, 75% Python) so that claim is kept but re-cited to the paper. Meta's paper (arXiv:2308.12950, Table 2) gives 43.3% HumanEval pass@1 and 49.0% MBPP pass@1 for Code Llama - Python 13B; on those correct figures Python 13B is actually very slightly ahead of Code Llama - Instruct 13B (42.7%), the reverse of the leaderboard-based 'scores lower than Instruct' disadvantage that was previously listed, so that item was removed (the ~0.6-point gap is too small to state as a new advantage). The maker's Hugging Face repo for this model now carries a 'non-official' notice pointing to the meta-llama org, so website_url and the maker source were updated to https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/CodeLlama-13b-Python-hf. Catalog facts (16384 max input/output tokens) are consistent with Fireworks' listed '16.3k tokens' context.
